row.evidence: Mode's Compare Plans table lists "SCIM (Okta)" as an Add-on on Pro and included on Enterprise, with SAML SSO only on Enterprise; the help centre says SCIM customers must complete SAML setup first.
row.notes: Mode is now owned by ThoughtSpot (mode.com banner). No public prices: Pro and Enterprise are 'Schedule a demo' (Pro minimum 3 users, Enterprise minimum 50). SCIM is a paid add-on on Pro and included in Enterprise, but SAML SSO (a SCIM prerequisite, and it must be the only sign-in method) is listed only on Enterprise, so in practice SCIM may need Enterprise. Help centre documents Okta (OIN app) and Azure AD (custom non-gallery app with ?aadOptscim062020). Deactivation removes the user from the org and all groups. REST API (paid plans) has membership, invite, group and audit-log endpoints.

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > Member Authorization > Enabled Okta SCIM / Enabled SCIM > View Config Settings (OAuth Bearer Token); switch may need the account manager

deprovision.data_retained: User is removed from the organization and all groups; reactivation restores the account but groups must be reassigned.

roles.how: SCIM role/roles attribute with value 'admin' makes the user a Mode admin; other values ignored. In Entra, an 'admin' app role mapped via AppRoleAssignmentsComplex to roles.

limitations.text: SAML must be set up first and must be the workspace's only sign-in method.
Okta Import Users, Import Groups and Sync Password are not supported.
Existing Mode groups are not mapped to Entra groups and must be re-created in Entra.
Pricing page labels the feature 'SCIM (Okta)' although the help centre documents Okta and Azure AD.

scim.notes: Base URL is shown per workspace in Workspace Settings > Member Authorization > View Config Settings; not published.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a member from the workspace (page prose says POST; the reference shows DELETE)
Invite a user to the workspace

okta.notes: OIN page (Mode Analytics) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Mode's guide creates a custom (non-gallery) Entra application pointed at the Mode SCIM 2.0 base URL; no Entra gallery tutorial found.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: This guide walks through the supported features, requirements and troubleshooting steps for setting up SCIM for Mode. SCIM is supported for both Okta and Azure Active Directory (AAD).

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Mode requires that SCIM customers have completed the SAML setup process and have a working Okta or AAD integration before setting up provisioning features with SCIM. Workspaces wishing to use SCIM are required to use SAML as their sole signin method.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Push User Deactivation : Deactivating the user through OKTA will remove the user from the organization and all groups in Mode. If they are reactivated they will need to have any groups reassigned to restore associated resource entitlements.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Push Profile Updates : Updates made to the user's profile through OKTA will be pushed to the third party application. First Name and Last Name will be combined as the Full Name in Mode.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Reactivate Users : Reactivating the user through Okta will reactivate the user in Mode.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Import Users , Import Groups , and Sync Password are not currently supported.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: On the Member Authorization tab on the Workspace Settings page, turn on the switch labeled Enabled Okta SCIM . Please note that if you don't see this switch, you should contact your account manager for further assistance.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Enter the SCIM 2.0 Base URL from the Mode SCIM config settings panel.Enter the OAuth Bearer Token from the Mode SCIM config settings panel.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Group Management : Mode supports group management through Okta's SCIM connector, so you can create, update, and deactivate groups directly in the IDP.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Mode supports users pushed from Okta with Okta mastering the userName , givenName , familyName , email , and emailType attributes.

citations.title: Authentication and SSO | Mode Help
citations.quote: Mode supports designating admin users via specifying admin as the value of the role attribute. Other values for role will be ignored.

conflicts.text: Compare Plans labels the feature 'SCIM (Okta)', while the help centre says SCIM is supported for both Okta and Azure Active Directory.
Pricing table offers SCIM as a Pro add-on, but SAML SSO (required before SCIM) is shown only on Enterprise.
The workspace-memberships reference says to remove a member with a POST request, but its endpoint block shows DELETE /{workspace}/memberships/{membership}.

open_questions: Prices of Pro, Enterprise and the SCIM add-on are not published.
Whether SAML (and therefore SCIM) can actually be bought on Pro is unclear from the pricing table.
SCIM base URL pattern, PUT vs PATCH, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
Whether removal frees a paid seat is not documented.
Which plan includes the audit-log API ('Admin-level API access' on Enterprise) is not stated.
